Question B-001-015-011.

Why the correct answer is right: For radio control of models, the bank allows all amateur radio bands above 30 MHz.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "50 MHz to 54 MHz only": Restricting model control to 50 MHz to 54 MHz leaves out other amateur bands above 30 MHz.
- sourceIndex 2: "All amateur radio bands": All amateur bands would include below-30-MHz bands, but the model-control privilege is limited to the above-30-MHz side.
- sourceIndex 3: "50 MHz to 54 MHz, 144 MHz to 148 MHz, and 222 MHz to 225 MHz only": These are only three VHF ranges; the rule is broader because it covers all amateur bands above 30 MHz.
